title: LandGuard Lite
description: Advanced Land Protection with Cloud Backups. Lightweight, fast, and battle-tested.
body:
![LandGuard Lite Banner](https://i.imgur.com/kdtaCbv.png)

**LandGuard Lite** is a free next-generation **anti-grief plugin** designed to keep your players' builds safe from griefing with unmatched performance and functionality.

**Why Next-Generation?**

All builds protected by LandGuard Lite are automatically backed up in the cloud (powered by MineSphere), ensuring that your players’ builds are always safe, even in case of a catastrophic failure on your server.

**What is MineSphere?**

[MineSphere](https://www.minesphere.app/) is a central hub for Minecraft players to showcase, explore, and interact with other builds. Players can share their creations, get inspired by others, leave hearts on their favorite builds, and connect with the wider community.

## Features

**🌍 Land Claiming & Protection**

Players can create and manage land claims to protect their builds from griefing and unwanted interactions.

**👥 Member & Permission Management**

Fine-grained control over who can build, interact, or access containers inside each claimed land.

**🚩 Protection Flags**

Configure per-land flags to control gameplay mechanics such as block breaking, placing, interactions, PvP, and more.

**💰 Economy Integration**

Supports server economies to charge for land creation, expansion, or maintenance, helping balance gameplay.

**📐 Flexible Land Management**

Resize, transfer, rename, and organize lands with ease using intuitive commands and tools.

**🌐 Multi-Language Support**

Fully localized messages with built-in translations for:

- English
- Spanish
- Chinese (Simplified)
- French
- Portuguese
- Arabic
- German
- Italian

**🔒 Strong Grief Prevention**

Automatically prevents unauthorized actions inside claims while remaining lightweight and performant.

**⚙️ Highly Configurable**

Designed to fit different server styles, from survival to semi-RPG, with extensive configuration options.

**🚀 Optimized & Server-Friendly**

Built with performance in mind to ensure smooth gameplay even on larger servers.

## FAQ

**What makes LandGuard Lite special?**

LandGuard Lite delivers powerful anti-griefing features for free. It includes easy to use GUIs, it’s highly performant, lightweight, and includes seamless and optional integration with economy systems through Vault.

But what truly sets LandGuard Lite apart? It’s the first free plugin to integrate with the MineSphere project - unlocking next-generation capabilities.

**Does this plugin have any dependencies?**

LandGuard Lite has no mandatory dependencies. If you need economy features, you must add Vault and an economy provider such as EssentialsX.

**How to connect my server to MineSphere?**

To connect your server to MineSphere, you must add a server id and an auth key to your plugin’s configuration. You can get these credentials by registering your server at https://www.minesphere.app/server/register

**Can I use LandGuard without a Database?**

If you own a small server and don’t have access to a database such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MariaDB, you can still use the plugin with SQLite. Your plugin will store data in a local file without the need for a more advanced database.
